review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines extEquivCohomologyClass (an Equiv), extAddEquivCohomologyClass (an AddEquiv), extLinearEquivCohomologyClass (a LinearEquiv) and the constructor extMk. The three equivalences are the usual layered bundling of one equivalence at increasing structure, and they build on each other. extMk is a new constructor for Ext classes from cocycles on a projective resolution. I found no competing definition in Mathlib. A grep for extMk and extEquivCohomologyClass matched only this file, the dual Injective/Ext.lean, and nothing in Abelian/Ext.lean. The injective file is the dual API for injective resolutions, not a duplicate. I did not read the injective file's contents. The instance `R.cochainComplex.IsKProjective` is a genuine instance, not a competing concept. I found no concrete duplication cost, so I abstain.
